page_faq_faq.title: All the answers
page_faq_faq.1_question: Do I need an account to order?
page_faq_faq.1_answer: No. You fill in the order form (name, phone, city, address) or go through the online checkout. No account is required.
page_faq_faq.2_answer: 24 to 48 hours in the major cities, 48 to 72 hours elsewhere in Morocco. We deliver only within Morocco.
page_faq_faq.3_answer: Yes, in cash to the courier, everywhere in Morocco. Online payment remains available at checkout.
page_faq_faq.4_question: How do I find my ring size?
page_faq_faq.4_answer: Measure your finger with a thread, then check the length against our size guide. If in doubt, send us the measurement on WhatsApp.
page_faq_faq.5_answer: Yes. Three-micron gold-plated 316L steel withstands the shower, the sea and perspiration. Just avoid direct contact with perfume.
page_faq_faq.6_question: How do I make a return?
page_faq_faq.6_answer: Write to us within 14 days. We arrange the return; the piece must be unworn and in its box.
